summary: C4 continuation of merged #1855/#1866/#1873/#1879. A positive SimpleIntentionalEminence assignment has the same source/secondary knower and actual self-apprehension with one real constituent. strictUnityExcludesNoesisUnderRealDuality conditionally excludes source noesis under the selected strong real-constituent duality principle; that is not the full Plotinian intelligible-articulation objection. Existing immanent self-form route remains the strongest positive conditional and source-level will and freedom remain separate. Even full support of uptake and duty in the stipulated groups leaves source apprehension open. Next test what makes the first agent’s act genuine understanding and its claimant’s title rightful, and whether the same explanation requires subject-level apprehension at the source. A physical impediment preserves understanding while bypassing practical basing. Removing the cognitive procedure separately breaks support for uptake. Neither comparison derives choice.
